title: Casting the oracle restricted weight estimate
statement: Let $n,a,b,s$ be natural numbers with $0<n$, $0<a$, $2a\le b$, and $1\le s$. Consider the restricted-weight input specified by dimension $n$, bias numerator $a$, bias denominator $b$, and Fourier bound $s$, and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. For any coordinate set $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and any $S\subseteq J$, the rational restricted weight estimate obtained by querying $f$ at every point of the prescribed query set, when viewed as a real number, equals the corresponding real restricted Fourier weight estimate of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the bias numerator is at most the bias denominator: $2a\le b$
